name: Digital Marketing & SEO
headline: Be found, be remembered, be chosen.
intro: Search, social and paid campaigns built on measurement, so your brand reaches the right people and every rupee of spend can be traced to an outcome.

overview.what: Digital marketing and SEO covers search engine optimisation, social media management, paid advertising across Google, Meta and WhatsApp, content, email and analytics, planned as one connected growth programme.
overview.why: Customers research online before they buy. If your brand is invisible in search or inconsistent on social platforms, competitors capture that attention, and unmeasured advertising wastes budget.
problems: A good website that nobody finds in search results
Social channels that post irregularly with no link to enquiries
Ad spend with unclear return and no conversion tracking
Campaigns that reach people but do not turn attention into leads
overview.approach: We begin with audience, competitors and tracking, then build a channel mix that suits your goals. Every campaign ships with reporting, and results feed back into the next round of content and targeting.

deliver.d: Technical audits, keyword strategy, on-page optimisation, content and link-earning for lasting organic growth.
Content calendars, creative, publishing, community replies and performance reporting.
Google Ads, Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp campaigns built around clear conversion goals.
Articles, landing pages, short video, graphics and email sequences aligned with your brand voice.
Analytics, tag management and dashboards that connect clicks to leads and sales.
Plain-language reviews of what worked, what did not and what to do next.

capabilities.d: Site speed, crawlability, structured data, mobile usability and Core Web Vitals fixes.
Google Business Profile optimisation, local citations and review management.
Interest, lookalike and retargeting audiences built from your customer and website data.
Structured variations of messages and visuals to learn what drives action.
Focused pages and forms that turn campaign traffic into enquiries.
Email and WhatsApp follow-up sequences triggered by user behaviour.

process.d: We review your site, competitors, keywords, audience and current campaign performance.
Channels, budgets and measurable targets are agreed for the first quarter.
Tracking, technical fixes, profiles and landing pages are put in place.
Content, ads and outreach go live on a planned calendar.
Budgets, audiences, keywords and creative are adjusted weekly using the data.
Monthly reviews decide where to invest more and where to stop.

benefits.d: Rank for the searches your customers make and appear consistently on the platforms they use.
Tracking ties spend and activity to enquiries and sales.
SEO and content keep working long after they are published.
A consistent voice and creative build recognition and trust.
Decisions come from performance data rather than opinion.

usecases.d: Local SEO and Google Business Profile work bring in nearby enquiries.
Product SEO, Instagram and search ads drive traffic to a new store.
Content, LinkedIn and search campaigns feed a qualified enquiry pipeline.
Seasonal admission campaigns across Meta, Google and WhatsApp.

cta.p: Share your goals and your current channels. We will audit what you have and outline the plan we would run.
